reason: H0 exclusively fuzzes PNG decoding, while the changed production logic is the encoder’s compressed text-chunk path. H0 never creates an encode-only context, calls spng_set_text(), or drives write_chunks_before_idat(), so it cannot exercise the new stateful deflate flow using ctx->text_options, deflateBound(), deflate(..., Z_FINISH), and zstream->total_out for compressed SPNG_ZTXT or SPNG_ITXT data.
evidence: tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c creates ctx with spng_ctx_new(SPNG_CTX_IGNORE_ADLER32) and only configures input through spng_set_png_file(), spng_set_png_stream(), or spng_set_png_buffer().
The harness calls spng_decoded_image_size(), spng_decode_image(), and spng_decode_row(); it has no encoding operation or encode-only context setup.
Although H0 calls spng_get_text(), it only inspects decoded struct spng_text entries and changes text[i].length; it never calls spng_set_text().
The changed branch is guarded by ctx->stored.text and text->compression_flag inside write_chunks_before_idat(), then initializes ctx->zstream with spng__deflate_init(ctx, &ctx->text_options).

The changed code derives text_length with strlen(text->text), allocates using deflateBound(zstream, text_length), performs deflate(zstream, Z_FINISH), and uses zstream->total_out—input and compression-state semantics absent from H0.
recommended_action: Add an encoding fuzz target that creates an encode-only spng_ctx, installs a valid IHDR, supplies fuzz-derived text entries through spng_set_text(), and completes PNG encoding so write_chunks_before_idat() runs. Cover SPNG_ZTXT and SPNG_ITXT with compression_flag enabled, varied NUL-terminated keywords/text/language fields, lengths and entry counts, and available text compression options; capture output through both buffer and stream-style encoder APIs where supported.
